idea-plugin.name: TornadoInsight
idea-plugin.description:
TornadoInsight is an open source IntelliJ plugin that aims to enhance the experience of developers when working with TornadoVM.
  • TornadoInsight provides a built-in on-the-fly static checker, empowering developers to identify unsupported Java features in TornadoVM and understand the reasons behind these limitations.
  • TornadoInsight introduces a dynamic testing framework that enables developers to easily test individual TornadoVM tasks. It automatically wraps TornadoVM tasks, invoking the native TornadoVM runtime on the developers' machines for seamless debugging and testing.

What's New in 1.6.0

TornadoInsight 1.6.0 adds compatibility with TornadoVM 6.0.0. The plugin reads the JDK requirement that TornadoVM 6.0.0 records in $TORNADOVM_HOME/etc/tornado.jdk and accepts any project JDK at or above that minimum. A GraalVM project JDK is now flagged with a clear error, because TornadoVM 6.0.0 and newer bundle their own Graal compiler and JVMCI and must run on a standard OpenJDK build.

What's New in 1.4.2

Important: Starting with version 1.4.2, the required environment variable has been renamed from TORNADO_SDK to TORNADOVM_HOME to align with TornadoVM's updated naming conventions. Please update your environment configuration before upgrading.

TornadoInsight 1.4.2 is compatible with TornadoVM 2.2.0 (onwards) and features automatic SDK detection. The plugin can now detect your installed TornadoVM SDK automatically without requiring a custom build from source. This streamlined setup makes it easier than ever to get started with TornadoVM development.

Getting started

TornadoInsight is available for versions 2023.1.7 and higher of compatible JetBrains IDEs. It invokes Java and TornadoVM at runtime on the computer where the plugin is installed, and therefore, developers must have installed Java and TornadoVM prior to using the plugin:
  • TornadoVM >= v2.2.0 (for TornadoInsight 1.4.2+); TornadoVM 6.0.0 is supported from TornadoInsight 1.6.0
  • JDK 21 or newer, matching the requirement of your TornadoVM SDK (a standard OpenJDK build, not a GraalVM one)

Install TornadoVM SDK

You can use SDKMAN! to install TornadoVM. The default version is OpenCL, but you can install any supported backend for your platform: 
sdk install tornadovm

Environment Variable Configuration (v1.4.2+)

Since version v1.4.2, TornadoInsight requires the TORNADOVM_HOME environment variable to be defined and visible to the IntelliJ IDEA process.

On modern operating systems, GUI applications (such as IntelliJ started from JetBrains Toolbox, the Dock, or an application launcher) do not always inherit shell variables defined in files like ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc. For this reason, TORNADOVM_HOME must be configured using OS-appropriate mechanisms, as described below. To find the path for your TornadoVM SDK, run: 

which tornado
Required Variable: 
TORNADOVM_HOME=/absolute/path/to/tornado-sdk
macOS:
  • Run in terminal: launchctl setenv TORNADOVM_HOME /absolute/path/to/tornado-sdk
  • Fully quit IntelliJ IDEA (Cmd + Q) and relaunch it
Linux (systemd):
  • Create directory: mkdir -p ~/.config/environment.d
  • Create file: ~/.config/environment.d/tornado.conf
  • Add line: TORNADOVM_HOME=/absolute/path/to/tornado-sdk
  • Log out and log back in, then start IntelliJ IDEA
Windows:
  • Open System Properties → Environment Variables
  • Add User variable: TORNADOVM_HOME=C:\path\to\tornado-sdk
  • Restart IntelliJ IDEA

Plugin Configuration

The dynamic inspection feature of TornadoInsight is configured after the installation of the plugin, as follows:
  • Navigate to "Settings" and select "TornadoInsight" from the menu.
  • With TornadoInsight 1.4.2+, the plugin automatically detects your installed TornadoVM SDK and uses the Java SDK from your Project Settings. You only need to indicate a tentative "array size" that can be used by TornadoInsight to set the size of the input and output arrays of a TornadoVM task.
For more information, please follow our documentation.
Enjoy and share your feedback!
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.6.0

  • TornadoVM 6.0.0 compatibility: The JDK compatibility check now reads the etc/tornado.jdk contract that TornadoVM 6.0.0 ships (minimum JDK plus preview flag) instead of the removed tornado --version JDK marker, and accepts any project JDK at or above that minimum.
  • GraalVM JDK guard: A GraalVM project JDK is detected and reported with a clear error instead of a JVM crash, since TornadoVM 6.0.0+ bundles its own Graal compiler and JVMCI.
  • The info console reports the resolved TornadoVM JDK requirement and the project JDK in use.

Version 1.4.2

  • Environment Variable Update: The required environment variable has been renamed from TORNADO_SDK to TORNADOVM_HOME to align with TornadoVM's updated naming conventions. Please update your environment configuration accordingly.

Version 1.4.0

  • TornadoVM 2.0+ Support: Full compatibility with TornadoVM 2.0 and later versions
  • Automatic SDK Detection: The plugin now automatically detects your installed TornadoVM SDK without requiring manual configuration of the TornadoVM root directory
  • Streamlined Setup: No longer requires building TornadoVM from source - works directly with installed TornadoVM SDK packages
  • Improved Configuration: Simplified settings panel without explicit declaration of the Java SDK path. Instead, the plugin reuses the user-defined Java SDK from Project Settings
